unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My brother has never been abroad before, so he is finding this trip very exciting.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 一只宽的(broad)小船漂到了国外(abroad)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: you have to tell your teacher about it when you are absent from class.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法: ab(离开) + sent(送) = 送走了就不在场，即缺席的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They accused the dishonest clerk of taking the company's money.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ac(去) + cuse(理由) = 提出指控的理由 -> 谴责、控诉(accuse)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 钦佩；赞赏；仰慕；(2) 欣赏
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There are two especially interesting things to admire about the Inca civilisation.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆：“额的妈呀”，太让人钦佩了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 承认(罪行、错误)；(2) 准许进入
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He was brave enough to admit his mistake to the teacher.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ad (向) + mit (送) -> 准许进入，承认。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We cannot afford to buy such an expensive computer right now.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：can afford to do sth. 负担得起做某事。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 对……产生影响（通常指情感、行为或状态）；(2) (疾病、环境等)侵袭，使感染；(3) 假装，佯装（某种情感或态度）
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: How does the weather affect us?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 前缀记忆：af- (表强调) + fect (做) -> 施加作用去影响。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The travel agent helped us book tickets for our summer holiday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：travel agent 旅行社代理人。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are reading more books about IT and AI.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: Artificial Intelligence 的首字母缩写

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 帮助，援助；`v.` 帮助；援助（指具体救助行为及促进社会发展的抽象作用，强调援助有效性）
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We received aid from the people.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：aid 帮助。first aid是急救。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: His aim is to become a helpful doctor in the future.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：aim at 瞄准；aim to do 旨在做某事。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 外星人；外国人 `adj.` 外国的；陌生的；外星的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sci-fi film tells a story about friendly aliens visiting Earth.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：科幻电影里的外星人（alien）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A large amount of money was donated to the children's hospital.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：a large amount of 大量的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 应用；运用；(2) 申请；请求
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: apply for a visa
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 字根记忆：ap（去）+ ply（折叠）→ 弯腰递交申请。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sometimes my friends and I argue but don't know how to make up.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 阿爸(ar)与你(gue)意见不合，开始争吵。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 进攻；攻击 `n.` 攻击；(疾病的)发作
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The brave dog barked loudly to protect the sheep from a wolf attack.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：under attack 遭受攻击。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 出席，参加；(2) 注意，专心；(3) 定期去(某处)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You attended the festival last year and this year.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：at(在)+tend(照料/倾向)→人到了现场去照料和关注→“参加;出席”

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the author want to express in this paragraph?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: author 指著书立说的大师级作者，比 writer 更加具有学术或专业色彩。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 避免；防止；(2) 躲避；回避；避开
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You should look both ways to avoid accidents when crossing the street.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：avoid doing sth. 避免做某事。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She won an award for the best speech in the English contest.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：win an award 获奖。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Are you aware of the importance of protecting the environment?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be aware of 意识到。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I know some rules are important, but this is awful!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 嗷夫(awful)，发出好糟糕的叫声。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My sister has practiced ballet since she was six years old.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 音译联想：芭蕾舞（ballet）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (尤指为男性理发、修面的)理发师
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dad went to the corner barber shop to get a haircut.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：barber shop 理发店。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 树皮，吠声 `v.` (狗)吠叫；厉声质问
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The dog starts to bark very loudly.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: b + ark(方舟)，狗在方舟上bark大叫

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 基础；根据；基底；`v.` 以……为总部(据点)；以……为基础
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The writer bases his argument on facts.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：爸爸(ba)色(se)衰，失去了家里的经济“基础”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 存在；生物；(2) be 的现在分词
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every living being on this planet needs clean water to survive.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：human being 人类；living being 生物。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Who does this T-shirt belong to?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：be-(使) + long(长久) -> 长久跟着你 -> 属于

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you put on your seat belt?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 抱他(belt)得先解开安全带。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 打赌；用……打赌 `n.` 打赌，赌注；预计
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I bet our school basketball team will win tomorrow's final.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：I bet (我敢肯定)。
